post.summary: Start an English game right away (no setup)
post.description:
Creates a paused stage of the game's lesson (the app shows a 3-2-1 countdown, then resumes it). The words or
questions are chosen from the user's level, history and review list: there is nothing to configure.
With a grade (or, outside school, a level) the game must have content for it: the curriculum games always need one.
The grade is always the learner's current one (education.py); the app cannot pick another.

Sổ tay từ vựng: words met in the vocabulary games, most recent first, a page at a time
get.description:
`counts` are for the whole history (the filter tabs); `total` is the number of words matching the filters and
search, of which `items` is the page from `offset`. filter: review (chưa nhớ, answered wrong), learned (đã học),
mastered (thành thạo), correct (learned or mastered). `topics` are the topics of the history, for the topic filter.

Per game. The grade is the learner's own (education profile), never one sent by the app. `levels[].status`:
completed | unlocked | locked | above_grade (beyond this grade's highest level). `celebration`: a completed level
not celebrated yet; show it once, then POST /levels/{game}/{level}/celebrated.

get.summary: The game definitions: every gameplay, what the learner does in it, and whether it is built
get.description:
The game definition table (game_registry.py): each gameplay's family (two of one family play the same way), its
interaction, grades, world, turn kind, status (ready / planned) and the learning activities it is made for. The
lessons that use each one: docs/GAME_AUDIT.md.

post.summary: Start a game of a lesson (created paused: 3-2-1 resumes it)
post.description:
The backend checks that the game belongs to this lesson, the lesson to its subject and grade, and that it is
ready and unlocked; the stage then draws only this lesson's content. A vocabulary game draws the lesson's own words
first, then new words beyond them (vocab_lesson.py). With no new word left: once the game is passed it does not
start (409 vocabulary_exhausted: the app offers Ôn tập); before that, it is a review of the lesson's own words
(`catalog.words_review`), which can pass the game, as nothing else could any more.

schema.title: Response Play Lesson Api Learning Lesson Catalog  Key  Play Post

409.description: code: lesson_locked | lesson_not_ready | lesson_not_published | open_session_exists | vocabulary_exhausted

get.summary: A subject of the learner's grade as a journey map: chapters, lessons and games with their unlock state
get.description:
Every chapter and lesson of the subject this school year with `status` LOCKED / UNLOCKED / IN_PROGRESS /
COMPLETED, what opens it (`requirements`), whether it is required, and `celebrate` while its unlock has not been
celebrated yet. Nothing the app sends changes a state: they follow from the stages it completed.

schema.title: Response Unlock Map Api Learning Unlock Map Get

post.summary: Catch up the unlocks of the learner's grade (after a lost result) and list those not celebrated yet
post.description:
The app calls this when it comes back online or after a result: the backend applies the rules again to the
stages it has recorded (a body, if any, is ignored: the app never says what is completed or open) and returns the
unlocks still to celebrate. Idempotent.

post.description:
Closes the learner's school year exactly like the automatic promotion (archive, history, once per year), only
once the next school year has begun by its expected date; a "học lại" hold keeps the grade as it would.

post.summary: Move a learner to another region's school calendar
post.description:
The school year already reached is kept: a region whose year starts later never moves the learner back, and one
whose year has already started promotes once, through the same per-year unique key as always.

schema.title: Response Admin Change Region Api Admin Education Users  User Id  Region Post

client_event_id.title: Client Event Id
client_event_id.description: Idempotency key chosen by the app per action; a retry with the same id changes nothing.

hold_next.title: Hold Next
hold_next.description: Falling words: when this turn ends, open no new turn. The app opens new words on its own timer (/next with refill), so a word comes in at the top on time, never in the place of the last one.

answer.title: Answer
answer.description: Typed text or number, an option id, the ordered token ids of a bridge, or (Phòng thí nghiệm) a part on every place as "slot:part". Dòng thời gian: every event on a marker as "marker:event"; Xây câu: the tile ids of the sentence in order; Xưởng hình học: ["angle:<degrees>"] or ["rect:<w>x<h>"]; Cân bằng phương trình: one coefficient per substance, in order. Cầu trục số: every point on a tick as "point:tick"; Giải toán từng bước: the current step as [chip, operator (+ - × :), chip, typed result]; Thám tử đọc hiểu: [sentence id] to find the clue, then [option id]; Soi câu: the painted pieces as "piece:highlighter" (["none"] when nothing is painted).

grade.title: Grade

level.title: Level

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: The support ticket or check that verified the request.

start_paused.title: Start Paused
start_paused.description: Create it paused (the app counts down 3-2-1, then /resume).

status.title: Status

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: THPT: the elective subjects studied (at most 4).

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: Grammar: mixed (default), gate or bridge. Vocabulary: meteor (Việt → Anh, default) or word_shooter (Anh → Việt).

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: Device timezone; becomes the account timezone if none is set.

start_paused.title: Start Paused
start_paused.description: Create it paused (the app shows the session's lesson first; the clock starts with /resume).

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.description: Học tập by lesson: the lesson, its grade and game, the other games of the lesson and the next lesson.

archive_year.title: Archive Year
archive_year.description: kind archive: the finished school year reviewed from Kho lưu trữ (its results stay as they were).

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: The support ticket or check that verified the request.

client_event_id.title: Client Event Id
client_event_id.description: Idempotency key chosen by the app per action; a retry with the same id changes nothing.

practice.title: Practice
practice.description: A re-practice turn after a revealed answer or a mistake in Học tập.

travel_seconds.title: Travel Seconds
travel_seconds.description: Challenge only: time for the target to reach the ground/base. 0 = waits.

on_screen_ms.title: On Screen Ms
on_screen_ms.description: Play time since the turn was issued, so a reopened game puts each target back where it was instead of at the top.

turn_id.title: Turn Id
turn_id.description: The turn this event resolved. A typed shot can hit another falling word than the one aimed at (the one closest to the ground whose answer matches).

correct_answer.title: Correct Answer
correct_answer.description: Only once the turn is resolved or revealed.

correct_options.title: Correct Options
correct_options.description: Multiple-choice games (Chọn đáp án, Chọn cổng, So sánh), once the turn is resolved or revealed: the ids of the right options, which the app marks in green. Never sent before an answer.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Curriculum games: why a wrong answer is wrong (it can be tried again), or what to do next.

word.description: Vocabulary: the English word and its Vietnamese meaning, once the turn is resolved or revealed.

kept.title: Kept
kept.description: Sắp xếp / Ghép cặp, after a wrong answer: the cards in the right place or the right pairs, which the app keeps (the subject gameplays likewise: events, tiles, points, painted pieces, or the right calculation of a step).

version.title: Version
version.description: The guide version the user finished (TUTORIAL_VERSION).
